overview.title: What is ONEfold?
overview.description: ONEfold is an app that manages all files related to a specific topic by gathering them into a single folder.
overview.supportFiles: Supported: Docs, Images, Videos, Audio, Links, Maps, Memos, etc.

privacy.title: Your Data Stays on Your Phone
privacy.desc: ONEfold does not store your files on any server. All data is kept securely inside your own smartphone.
privacy.note: Please note that internet links and map features require an external connection.

items.a: Yes, all features are currently free to use.
Yes, local files and notes are accessible offline. Web links and maps require an internet connection.
Files are stored only on your local device and are never uploaded to any external servers.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.content: ONEfold values your privacy. We do not store any personal data on our servers. All files and notes remain on your local device.
